acceptance_criteria.statement: The integrated released runtime passes restart/recovery, uninterrupted 24-hour and 72-hour operation, post-release verification, and the deterministic Completion Gate without unresolved blockers.

definition_of_done: 72-hour run includes recovery and incident drills.
description: Run the final unattended, recovery, release, and post-release qualification ladder in order and preserve every failure and recovery observation.
exclusions: Shortened or simulated duration cannot substitute for 24-hour or 72-hour qualification.
No completion while external blockers remain.
objective: Pass 24-hour, 72-hour, release, and post-release Completion qualification
observability_impact: Retain continuous health, cycle, incident, cost, recovery, release, and completion observations.
rationale: Only long-running operational evidence can qualify a continuously operating product.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Checkpoint continuously; stop and preserve evidence on safety, integrity, budget, or recovery threshold breach.
security_impact: Long-running credentials and workers require leases, rotation, revocation, budget limits, and incident response.
title: Unattended operation, release, and Completion qualification
